define <4 x i16> @wide_zext_v4i16(<4 x i16> %a, <4 x i16> %b) {
  %x = zext <4 x i16> %a to <4 x i32>
  %y = zext <4 x i16> %b to <4 x i32>
  %d = sub <4 x i32> %x, %y
  %s = lshr <4 x i32> %d, splat (i32 1)
  %r = trunc <4 x i32> %s to <4 x i16>
  ret <4 x i16> %r
}

define <2 x i32> @test_pasubu_w(<2 x i32> %a, <2 x i32> %b) {
  %a_ext = zext <2 x i32> %a to <2 x i64>
  %b_ext = zext <2 x i32> %b to <2 x i64>
  %sub = sub <2 x i64> %a_ext, %b_ext
  %res = lshr <2 x i64> %sub, splat (i64 1)
  %res_trunc = trunc <2 x i64> %res to <2 x i32>
  ret <2 x i32> %res_trunc
}

}

define <8 x i8> @test_pasubu_b(<8 x i8> %a, <8 x i8> %b) {

  %b_ext = zext <8 x i8> %b to <8 x i16>

  %res = lshr <8 x i16> %sub, splat (i16 1)

  ret <8 x i8> %res_trunc
}

@G = external global i64

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @lshr_32bytes(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %byteOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %LGV = load i64, ptr @G, align 4
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %byteOff = load i256, ptr %byteOff.ptr, align 1
  %B = lshr i64 0, %LGV
  %bitOff = shl i256 %byteOff, 3
  %res = lshr i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i64 %B, ptr poison, align 4
  ret void
}

  %B = ashr i128 %r, %l
  %0 = tail call { i128, i1 } @llvm.umul.with.overflow.i128(i128 %l, i128 %r) #2

  ret { i128, i8 } %5
}

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @lshr_16bytes(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %bitOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %A = alloca i128, align 8
  store i128 poison, ptr %A, align 4
  %src = load i128, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %bitOff = load i128, ptr %bitOff.ptr, align 1
  %res = lshr i128 %src, %bitOff
  store i128 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i128 %bitOff, ptr %A, align 4
  ret void
}
